{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust downward bias in forecasts when sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., >2 consecutive negative values).",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment is strongly bullish.",
    "Increase downward bias when true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., >3 consecutive underperformance).",
    "When sentiment turns positive after a downtrend, slightly increase forecast to reflect potential rebound, but avoid overcorrection.",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment shifts; lagged sentiment (e.g., 2-3 day average) should guide correction more than immediate sentiment.",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, reduce volatility in predictions when sentiment is flat or mildly negative; price tends to consolidate."
  ]
}
